taxonomy.name: Espresso Shot Quality
taxonomy.definition: Taste and extraction quality of shots: sourness, bitterness, balance, body, crema, channeling, and flavor results from profiles or pre-infusion.

taxonomy.name: Brew Temperature Stability
taxonomy.definition: How accurately and consistently the machine holds brew temperature, including display accuracy, PID control, and back-to-back shots.

taxonomy.name: Warm-up Time and Scheduling
taxonomy.definition: How long the machine takes to become ready from cold or standby, plus timers, eco mode, and wake-on schedules.

taxonomy.name: Built-in Grinder Performance
taxonomy.definition: Grind consistency, adjustment steps, retention, dosing accuracy, clumping, burr options, and grinder behavior with different roasts.

taxonomy.name: Steam Wand and Milk Texturing
taxonomy.definition: Steam power, microfoam quality, wand ergonomics and articulation, milk temperature, plant milks, and steam readiness.

taxonomy.name: Noise and Vibration
taxonomy.definition: Loudness of the grinder, pump and steaming, beeps, vibration, and whether the machine disturbs others.

taxonomy.name: Touchscreen, Controls and Profiles
taxonomy.definition: Usability of the touchscreen, buttons, dial, menus, saved profiles, flow profiling, readouts, firmware updates, and screen lock.

taxonomy.name: Cleaning and Descaling Upkeep
taxonomy.definition: Routine cleaning, backflush, descaling effort, drip tray and puck handling, filters, consumables, and mess from grounds.

taxonomy.name: Support, Warranty and Repairs
taxonomy.definition: Experiences with customer service, warranty claims, repair turnaround, spare parts availability, and service coverage.

taxonomy.name: Design, Size and Water Tank
taxonomy.definition: Physical size, footprint, finish options, hopper and tank capacity and access, accessories, cable length, and packaging or delivery condition.

taxonomy.name: Overall Verdict and Value
taxonomy.definition: Whether the machine is worth its price and recommendable, including mixed feelings about returning or keeping it despite strengths.

taxonomy.name: Video Requests and Production
taxonomy.definition: Suggestions for future tests or content, and remarks about the video's editing, scoring gags, setting, and presentation.
